summary: The queue attributes the refusal to steal.c:remove_worn_item, but that helper is already implemented in js/steal.js. The first mismatch is caused by an obsolete UnsupportedWearError in js/do_wear.js:accessory_or_armor_on: C do_wear.c:2363-2364 calls remove_worn_item(obj, FALSE) when selected armor carries W_WEAPONS, while JavaScript refuses before the existing helper can clear the weapon-slot ownership. Replace the refusal with the source call. The helper returns no value used by accessory_or_armor_on; it performs the required worn-mask and slot updates.

source.branch: accessory_or_armor_on, lines 2359-2364: after retouch_object succeeds, when armor is selected and obj->owornmask contains W_WEAPONS, call remove_worn_item(obj, FALSE) before setworn. The helper must clear the weapon-slot ownership while preserving the object for the new armor slot.
